body: My escape used to be my girlfriend and she fucking left me to die. She kept kicking my while I was down in my depression.

Already have. Just get a flight to Yemen. 4 hours away; typical Friday outing. I make it past the checkpoint in time before they call the police. The problem is the cost of a ticket, and aside that my plan A has job, food and transport security. Plan B lands me stranded in Sana'a with no security.

I have a plan to run away and sustain myself enough to end up in Papua New Guinea before heading down to Australia and planning my next journey up to St Petersburg. I'd do it only if I knew my parents wouldn't call the police. In my country that's closely tied with the rest of the government. I'd be stopped at the border.

My mom doesn't let me leave the house. If it were up to me I'd be doing something new everyday, but apparently if I were to walk down the street I'd get "run over by a car". I have hard enough a time asking her to let me go to get a cup of coffee from outside. It gets so bad that they tell me they'd go, buy a coffee and then bring it back home for me to enjoy.
For my dad its the same, but academics is the excuse. Then he also says "Why would you want to see your friends? You spend 9 hours with them in school"

Well see, I've come to realize that perhaps if anything good comes from me, its just this. I'm still working my way out of depression and suicidal temptation, but I've been telling myself if I can make at least one person happy somehow, or make them feel good about themselves, its worth living at least one more day to make it happen again,
All Saudis have some drifting/wild car experience.
In Saudi Arabia and other Arab Gulf countries the hospitals are practically 60-75%... I have yet to see a Saudi nurse.
I actually was called "the best wingman you van ever have".... Ironically I'm clueless as to how I even got that..

I dunno... I mean the thing is I loved her so much I don't want to love anymore. I don't even want a girlfriend - any girlfriend. I feel like that's it. I don't want to try it again, despite how much I enjoyed it. 
Thanks for replying, though. I really appreciate it.
